info.name: StockCoreAPI
info.description:
## StockCoreAPI

StockCoreAPI is a RESTful API for managing the core operations of an inventory and sales system. It covers product catalog management, supplier relationships, inventory tracking, stock movements, customers, and sales orders.

### Authentication

All requests are authenticated using a **Bearer Token**. Use the `Login` endpoint to obtain a token and `Logout` to invalidate it. The token is stored in the `{{token}}` collection variable and automatically applied to every request.

### Modules

| Folder | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Auth** | Login and logout endpoints for session management. |
| **Products** | Create, retrieve, and update products in the catalog. |
| **Categories** | Manage product categories and browse products by category. |
| **Suppliers** | Manage supplier records and associate them with products. |
| **Product Suppliers** | Attach, update, and detach supplier relationships for individual products. |
| **Inventory** | View and update stock levels for each product. |
| **Stock Movements** | Record and query stock entries and exits across the system. |
| **Customers** | Manage customer records linked to stock operations. |
| **Orders** | Create and query sales orders and their associated items. |

### Variables

- `{{base_url}}` — The base URL of the API server.
    
- `{{token}}` — The Bearer token used for authentication.

request.description:
**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/products`

Returns a paginated list of all products in the catalog.

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | — | Page number for pagination (default: `1`) |

## Response Schema `200 OK`

```json
{
    "data": [
        {
            "id": "integer",
            "name": "string",
            "description": "string",
            "price": "number",
            "is_active": "boolean",
            "created_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
            "updated_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
            "categories": [
                {
                    "id": "integer",
                    "name": "string"
                }
            ]
        }
    ],
    "links": {
        "first": "string",
        "last": "string",
        "prev": "string | null",
        "next": "string | null"
    },
    "meta": {
        "current_page": "integer",
        "from": "integer",
        "last_page": "integer",
        "per_page": "integer",
        "to": "integer",
        "total": "integer"
    }
}
```

**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/products/:product`

Returns the details of a single product by its ID.

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:product` | integer | ✓ | The ID of the product |

## Response Schema `200 OK`

```json
{
    "data": {
        "id": "integer",
        "name": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "price": "number",
        "is_active": "boolean",
        "created_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
        "updated_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
        "categories": [
            {
                "id": "integer",
                "name": "string"
            }
        ]
    }

```

## Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `404 Not Found` | Product does not exist |

request.description:
**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/products`

Creates a new product in the catalog. Optionally assigns it to one or more categories.

## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | ✓ | Product name |
| `description` | string | — | Product description |
| `price` | number | ✓ | Unit price (decimal) |
| `is_active` | boolean | — | Whether the product is active (default: `true`) |
| `categories` | integer[] | — | Array of category IDs to assign |

### Example
```json
{
    "name": "OLED Display Module",
    "description": "I2C 128x64 pixels screen for microcontrollers",
    "price": 18500.00,
    "is_active": true,
    "categories": [2, 4]
}
```

## Response Schema `201 Created`

```json
{
    "data": {
        "id": "integer",
        "name": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "price": "number",
        "is_active": "boolean",
        "created_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
        "updated_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
        "categories": [
            {
                "id": "integer",
                "name": "string"
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Validation error — missing or invalid fields |

**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/products/:product`

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:product` | integer | ✓ | The ID of the product to update |

## Request Body

All fields are optional. Only include the fields you want to update.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | New product name |
| `description` | string | New product description |
| `price` | number | New unit price |
| `is_active` | boolean | Active status |
| `categories` | integer[] | Replace assigned category IDs |

### Example
```json
{
    "name": "Test postman",
    "price": 5000,
    "description": "Producto actualizado por postman"
}
```

## Response Schema `200 OK`

```json
{
    "data": {
        "id": "integer",
        "name": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "price": "number",
        "is_active": "boolean",
        "created_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
        "updated_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
        "categories": [
            {
                "id": "integer",
                "name": "string"
            }
        ]
    }
}
```

## Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `404 Not Found` | Product does not exist |
| `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Validation error |

item.name: Auth

request.description:
**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/login`

Authenticates a user and returns a Bearer token to be used in subsequent requests. The token is automatically stored in the `{{token}}` collection variable.

## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | ✓ | Registered user email address |
| `password` | string | ✓ | User password |

### Example
```json
{
    "email": "admin@stockcore.test",
    "password": "password123"
}
```

## Response Schema `200 OK`

```json
{
    "token": "string"
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `token` | string | Bearer token for authenticated requests |

## Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `401 Unauthorized` | Invalid credentials |
| `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Validation error — missing or malformed fields |

**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/logout`

Invalidates the current Bearer token, ending the authenticated session. Requires a valid `{{token}}` in the Authorization header.

## Response Schema `200 OK`

```json
{
    "message": "string"
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | Confirmation message, e.g. `"Logged out successfully"` |

## Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `401 Unauthorized` | Token is missing or already invalidated |

item.name: Product Suppliers

request.description:
**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/products/:product/suppliers`

Associates a supplier with a product, setting the supplier-specific SKU and cost.

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:product` | integer | ✓ | The ID of the product |

## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `supplier_id` | integer | ✓ | The ID of the supplier to attach |
| `supplier_sku` | string | — | Supplier's internal SKU for this product |
| `cost` | number | — | Purchase cost from this supplier |

### Example
```json
{
    "supplier_id": 5,
    "supplier_sku": "SUP-002",
    "cost": 85000
}
```

## Response Schema `201 Created`

```json
{
    "data": {
        "id": "integer",
        "name": "string",
        "tax_id": "string",
        "email": "string",
        "phone": "string",
        "is_active": "boolean",
        "pivot": {
            "product_id": "integer",
            "supplier_id": "integer",
            "supplier_sku": "string",
            "cost": "number"
        }
    }
}
```

## Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `404 Not Found` | Product or supplier does not exist |
| `409 Conflict` | Supplier is already attached to this product |
| `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Validation error |

item.name: Stock Movements

request.description:
**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/products/:product/stock-movements`

Records a stock movement for a specific product, adjusting its inventory quantity. Movements can represent entries, exits, or manual adjustments.

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:product` | integer | ✓ | The ID of the product |

## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | ✓ | Movement type: `entry`, `exit`, or `adjustment` |
| `quantity` | integer | ✓ | Number of units. Use positive values for entries/adjustments and negative for exits |
| `reason` | string | — | Description or reason for the movement |

### Example
```json
{
    "type": "adjustment",
    "quantity": 15,
    "reason": "Ajuste de inventario"
}
```

## Response Schema `201 Created`

```json
{
    "data": {
        "id": "integer",
        "product_id": "integer",
        "type": "string",
        "quantity": "integer",
        "reason": "string",
        "created_at": "string (ISO 8601)",
        "updated_at": "string (ISO 8601)"
    }
}
```

## Error Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `404 Not Found` | Product does not exist |
| `422 Unprocessable Entity` | Validation error — missing or invalid fields |

**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/products/:product/stock-movements`

Returns a paginated list of all stock movements for a specific product.

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:product` | integer | ✓ | The ID of the product |

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | — | Page number for pagination (default: `1`) |
| `type` | string | — | Filter by movement type: `entry`, `exit`, or `adjustment` |

## Response Schema `200 OK`

```json
{
    "data": [
```

**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:8000/api/v1/orders`

Creates a new order for a customer, specifying the products and quantities to include.

## Request Body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customer_id` | integer |  | The ID of the customer placing the order |
| `items` | array | ✓ | List of order items |
| `items[].product_id` | integer | ✓ | The ID of the product |
| `items[].quantity` | integer | ✓ | Quantity of the product to order |

### Example

``` json
{
    "customer_id": 2,
    "items": [
        {
            "product_id": 2,
            "quantity": 2
        },
        {
            "product_id": 5,
            "quantity": 3
        }
    ]
}

 ```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `customer_id` | integer | — | Filter orders by customer ID |
| `user` | integer | — | Filter orders by user ID |
| `order_id` | integer | — | Filter by a specific order ID |
